title: Birthday giving guide | Celebrate for Change
description: Make your celebration a reason to give. Browse organisations by cause and where they work, then support them on their own websites.

title: Birthday Giving in India | Celebrate for Change
description: Explore organisations working in India on education, older people’s care, child rights, school meals and the environment. Give on their own websites.

title: Birthday Giving in the United States | Celebrate for Change

description: Explore teacher development, older people’s support and conservation with clear work locations and links to organisations’ official giving pages.

title: International Celebration Giving | Celebrate for Change
description: Compare international environmental organisations, donation pages, gift memberships and plastic certificates. Check the terms on each official website.

title: About this student-built guide | Celebrate for Change
description: Meet Celebrate for Change, a student project by Rignesh that helps people discover organisations to support through birthdays and other celebrations.

title: Disclaimer and privacy | Celebrate for Change
description: Celebrate for Change does not collect or process donations. Read about external websites, listing limitations and the local birthday-message tool.

title: How listings are selected and checked | Celebrate for Change
description: Understand the guide’s source checks, selection limits, work-location labels and outgoing link types. These are not independent impact evaluations.

title: Write a birthday giving message | Celebrate for Change
description: Make an editable birthday message asking friends to support an organisation instead of buying gifts. Copy it or open your device’s share sheet.
